mentions.name: Figarooo
mentions.description: A map guessing game that shows world maps with labels and axes redacted (e.g., a map where the Netherlands is darkest for average height by country), challenging players to deduce what data the map represents. A hinting system provides difficulty tuning and feedback and is still a work in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a map guessing game where you're given a map with the labels/axis redacted, and then you have to guess what it's a map of.
